reviews.title: Aorus motherboard simple
reviews.comment: Installed motherboard was extremely quick and easy. Had plenty of m.2 slot for my build and plenty of connections for RGB even though I don't use much for RGB. Paired with ryzen 7 9800x3d it seems to run rather smooth only have had it for a week now but pretty amazing board. The interface for bios is very well thought out and the software it comes with makes it easy to change things for system setup.
